title: Consumer Alert: Phishing scams claim to be from Apple tech support
description: CINCINNATI (WKRC) – Do you keep getting calls from telemarketers claiming to be from Apple technical support?   If so, you're not alone. It's happening all over the country and beware: It's a scam seeking your personal information. The scammers may even “spoof” the call, making it appear to be coming from a legitimate company.  Shirley Rooker is the president of Call For Action in Washington D.C. She says scammers are constantly evolving.  "They're good. They're getting better all the time, and I think that's why consumers are so vulnerable because of the sophistication of the calls,” said Rooker.  The latest scam asks for remote access to your devices.  "Apple would not be calling you unless you have called them asking for authentication for an item,” said Rooker.  The scammers aren't settling for just phone calls. Emails are going out too. Kim Blanke got one on Wednesday.  "It says it was from Apple support regarding purchase, and it was an invoice and I thought I haven't purchased anything,” said Blanke.  Blanke says she opened the email for the $50 gift card but also changed her passwords, becoming suspicious of the email.  "I hit submit, then it pops up and needs to verify my information, first name, last name, address, social security number and I, of course, was not filling these out and said nope and closed the windows,” said Blanke. “I closed the Yahoo window, removed the app from my phone, just being cautious as I could. "  Being cautious is the advice Rooker gives. Don't answer numbers you don't know and don't give out your information. She says you have to protect yourself because scammers aren't going away.  "Unfortunately there is no magic bullet. We haven't found the perfect way to stop them,” said Rooker.  Call For Action gives you a place to turn for help. Volunteers at Local 12 help you solve your consumer problems, and if you have a sincere desire to help people, apply to be a Call For Action volunteer call 513-763-5599.
